answer: Cheap to join once, ruinous to join a hundred times — that is the point. One name, one proof, one entry: Lambbound calf clerk roll warrant enforces it, and a warrant calf clerks show after parchment office trials is how the check runs. Nobody is waved through free: 4 hours at the counter for every name, counted one by one is the price, and the thread never covers it twice. One purse cannot stretch across a hundred tolls, so the farm stalls at the gate. Every quartz is counted once. The jade is on the docket.
